explanations: Versions are boxed Long objects and the repository compares them with !=, which compares references, not values. Long.valueOf caches only -128..127, so for small versions two boxes of the same number happen to be the same object and the check works. Once a version exceeds 127, the expectedVersion boxed from the caller's primitive is a different object from the stored one, the comparison says they differ, and every valid update is rejected as stale. equals() compares the numeric value and fixes it.
